name: ai.haymon/dbmcp
description: Database MCP server for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL & SQLite with PII redaction and write-prevention

packageArguments.name: --dangerously-allow-unauthenticated
packageArguments.description: Allow a non-loopback bind without HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN (only behind an authenticating reverse proxy)

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required on every request; mandatory for non-loopback binds

packageArguments.name: --db-host
packageArguments.description: Database host (as seen from the SSH server when tunnelling)

packageArguments.name: --db-name
packageArguments.description: Database name or SQLite file path

packageArguments.name: --ssh-host
packageArguments.description: SSH server host; enables the tunnel when set

packageArguments.name: --ssh-key
packageArguments.description: Path to SSH private key (OpenSSH, PKCS#1, PKCS#8, SEC1)

packageArguments.name: --ssh-key-passphrase
packageArguments.description: Passphrase for the SSH private key

packageArguments.name: --ssh-strict-host-key-checking
packageArguments.description: Host key policy: yes rejects unknown hosts, accept-new trusts on first use, no disables verification (insecure)

packageArguments.name: --ssh-keepalive-interval
packageArguments.description: SSH keepalive interval in seconds (0 disables)

packageArguments.name: --db-page-size
packageArguments.description: Maximum items returned in a single paginated tool response (1-500)

packageArguments.name: --pii
packageArguments.description: Enable PII redaction of query tool output

packageArguments.name: --pii-operator
packageArguments.description: Operator applied to detected PII spans

packageArguments.name: --pii-categories
packageArguments.description: Comma-separated PII categories to detect (default: all). Values: personal, financial, government, contact, network, digital-identity, crypto

packageArguments.name: --pii-ner
packageArguments.description: Enable the optional ML/NER pass (person & location detection)

packageArguments.name: --pii-ner-model
packageArguments.description: Path to the NER model directory (required with --pii-ner)

packageArguments.name: --log-level
packageArguments.description: Log level: error, warn, info, debug, trace

environmentVariables.name: DB_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Database host, as seen from the SSH server when tunnelling (default: 127.0.0.1)

environmentVariables.name: DB_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Database name or SQLite file path

environmentVariables.name: SSH_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SSH server host; enables the tunnel when set

environmentVariables.name: SSH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to SSH private key (OpenSSH, PKCS#1, PKCS#8, SEC1)

environmentVariables.name: SSH_KEY_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for the SSH private key

environmentVariables.name: SSH_STRICT_HOST_KEY_CHECKING
environmentVariables.description: Host key policy: yes rejects unknown hosts, accept-new trusts on first use, no disables verification (insecure)

environmentVariables.name: SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: SSH keepalive interval in seconds (0 disables)

environmentVariables.name: DB_PAGE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum items returned in a single paginated tool response (1-500)

environmentVariables.name: PII_ENABLE
environmentVariables.description: Enable PII redaction of query tool output

environmentVariables.name: PII_OPERATOR
environmentVariables.description: Operator applied to detected PII spans

environmentVariables.name: PII_CATEGORIES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated PII categories to detect (default: all). Values: personal, financial, government, contact, network, digital-identity, crypto

environmentVariables.name: PII_NER_ENABLE
environmentVariables.description: Enable the optional ML/NER pass (person & location detection)

environmentVariables.name: PII_NER_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Path to the NER model directory (required with PII_NER_ENABLE=true)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level: error, warn, info, debug, trace
